references.text: The Lord hardened Pharaoh's heart, so that he would not let the people of Israel go. This shows the same pattern where God hardens hearts to fulfill his plan.
God says he will harden Pharaoh's heart. This is parallel to how God hardened the hearts of the Canaanites.
The Lord hardened Sihon's spirit and made his heart unyielding, so that God could deliver him into Israel's hands.
Moses' command to strike the nations with the ban and show them no mercy, as referenced in Joshua 11:20.
The command to strike with the ban all who live in the cities the Lord gives Israel, without letting anyone who breathes survive.
Eli's sons did not listen to their father, for the Lord intended to put them to death. Shows the same principle of God's sovereign plan.
Paul quotes about Pharaoh and teaches that God hardens whom he wills, illustrating God's sovereignty.
Israel was hardened, and God gave them a spirit of stupor. Shows that God can harden people as part of his plan.
